name: local-chain
description: Local chain setup to support Taho extension development.
author: Gergo Nagy<gergo.nagy@tally.cash>

scripts.start: anvil --chain-id 1337 --fork-url "${CHAIN_API_URL:?Set CHAIN_API_URL to an Ethereum mainnet RPC URL}" --block-time 5 --order fifo --disable-code-size-limit --timeout 5000
